name: sandbox-runtime (srt)
author: Anthropic

amendments.append: Agent processes with no built-in sandbox, including headless runners (AGT-6), other agent CLIs and local stdio MCP servers, run inside an OS-level sandbox with the same rules: a network allow-list, credential paths denied, and failing closed. For example, use `srt` from a pinned `@anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime` release; the sandboxed command is pinned too (AGT-5).

notes: Pre-1.0 (v0.0.83). Named as an example, not mandated, so an equivalent OS sandbox (bubblewrap, a container under AGT-3) satisfies the amendment. The repo is not installed into the kit.
rationale: Distilled, not installed. It is the only open, cross-platform OS sandbox that wraps arbitrary agent processes and stdio MCP servers, and it is the mechanism behind Claude Code's own sandbox, so it closes the gap in AGT-2 for agents that have none. A container (AGT-3) was the alternative; it is heavier and doesn't fit a developer laptop. Pre-1.0, so it is named as an example only.
